key_insight: BINEVAL turns LLM evaluation into a set of atomic binary questions, making scores more interpretable and easier to debug while remaining competitive with strong automatic judges.
engineering_relevance: It offers a training-free, task-agnostic evaluation workflow that can be plugged into NLP pipelines to diagnose failures and iteratively improve prompts.
method: Generate fine-grained evaluation questions from the task prompt with a meta-prompt.
Answer each binary question independently for every model output.
Aggregate question-level verdicts into multi-dimensional and overall calibrated scores, with feedback usable for prompt optimization.
evidence_signal: Across SummEval, Topical-Chat, and QAGS, BINEVAL matches or outperforms UniEval and G-Eval, with especially strong gains on factual consistency in QAGS and better alignment to human score distributions.
watch_item: Because the method relies on LLM-generated questions and judgments, performance may depend on prompt quality, judge choice, and calibration across tasks.
paper_title: Ask, Don't Judge: Binary Questions for Interpretable LLM Evaluation and Self-Improvement
